title: Spec 014 Durable Tenant One-shot Enablement Registry

phases.objective: Implement an unmounted async SQL registry that preserves exact registration replay and consumes each Tenant execution enablement at most once.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Durable Tenant Enablement Registry Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: An exact authorization/operation/run-bound enablement transitions once from generation N and unconsumed to generation N+1 and consumed, with an immutable receipt, while replay, expiry, CAS, second-use, migration, mount, and provider boundaries remain fail-closed.
steps: Require signed schema verification bound to the exact two-table enablement contract and exact deployed runtime parity.
Create the canonical registry without opening a database connection or exposing the raw pool.
Register an unconsumed enablement with positive generation, exact authorization digest, operation, run, and expiry bindings.
Replay the exact registration while rejecting the same ID with different evidence.
Reject consumption when authorization, operation, run, generation, or expiry no longer matches.
Consume the enablement using advisory lock, row lock, generation/consumed/row-version CAS, and generation increment by one.
Insert one immutable consumption receipt in the same transaction and verify current row plus receipt before commit.
Reject every second consumption and require an explicit fresh read rather than automatic retry.
Rollback a forced CAS miss without creating a consumption receipt.
Export secret-free current records and immutable receipts while route, worker, provider, migration, and production flags remain false.
assertions: The current enablement row and immutable consumption receipt are changed in one transaction under the shared advisory lock.
The current row may transition exactly once from unconsumed generation N to consumed generation N+1.
Every successful insert or consumption requires exact same-transaction readback.
Duplicate, orphan, or disagreeing consumption receipts fail closed.
The contract-local DDL is not placed in the runtime migration directory or promoted into Wave 1 through Wave 3.
The current synchronous memory-only Tenant Canary is not modified and compatibility remains false.
No route, server, worker, provider, Hostinger, deployment, main, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Promote and apply the schema through a separately authorized migration cycle, capture signed live readback, and connect the registry through the async Tenant runtime bridge.
blockers: The contract-local DDL has not been promoted into a checksum-bound runtime migration sequence.
No live migration authorization, dry-run, apply, or same-cycle table/index/constraint readback exists.
No signed live enablement-registry schema verification exists.
The current Tenant Canary remains synchronous and memory-factory-owned.
No route or worker mount authorization exists.

phases.objective: Prove restart reconstruction, concurrent consumption attempts, interrupted receipt insertion, stale expiry evidence, and orphan-receipt detection.
This slice does not execute a live Tenant or database canary.
Production schema apply, runtime mount, and provider dispatch remain separately governed and blocked.
